newsitem.title: INDIA: Philips opens software unit in Bangalore.
newsitem.headline: Philips opens software unit in Bangalore.

text.p: Electronics giant Philips Electronics N.V on Friday inaugurated a software centre, built at an estimated cost of $2.5 million, in India's southern city of Bangalore, a company official said.
The unit will be a fully-owned subsidiary of Philips Electronics N.V.
"The centre will design and develop software exclusively for our products worldwide," D. Dunn, head of Philips' consumer electronics division told reporters.
Dunn said the unit will design consumer electronic goods, medical systems, industrial electronic products and semi-conductors.
